lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.title: Compact native properties preserve complete geometry and rich editor state
value.statement: SQLite originals remain authoritative for project data; compatibility rich Java features and single-original editor overlays retain their complete original geometry/properties. Native-only copies retain geometry, all parts/rings/coordinates, bbox, feature/layer/order and GeoJSON identities, unknown properties and applicable explicit overrides. Drop only verified native-unused fields and properties not consumed by that source role. Polygon label points require a nonempty signature and carry label inputs rather than geometry paint; point sources retain both roles, and line geometry retains the native-query label fallback inputs. Preserve rule layout/dash keys, custom zoom curves, label gates and actual paint values. Uniform polygon sparsity requires the exact SimpleFeatureRenderer/SimplePolygonStyle context and matching factory defaults; missing context uses conservative projection. Initial/reload/edit/save, including all six MLP background constructors, must not restore the full rich native payload. Selected/tool/vertex sources and the public polygon anchor helper keep their prior contract. Styled URI files cannot bypass the projection. Transport counts contain IDs/counts only and are not native-memory attribution; neither pruning nor unit success is an OOM guarantee.
